doc.title: Pete Barbutti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 8, 2022

title: Timing, tempo and the punch line
summary: Comic timing comes from musical tempo and rhythm.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Yeah. And my other question was when I’ve watched some of your shows on video, like most comedians the timing and the space, the silence followed by the punch line is so much a part of the success. And was that something you learned over the years?
Yeah. And that’s the application of the music too that’s so important to the tempo and rhythm and people will laugh at something that isn’t even funny if the tempo and the rhythm is right you know.
